title: Public Alert No. 015/2025 – Recall of Substandard Juhel Folic Acid Tablet

products.manufacturer: Juhel Pharma Ltd. 35, Nkwubor Road Emene – Enugu

summary: NAFDAC recalls one batch of Juhel Folic Acid 5mg x1000 tablets found substandard during February 2025 post-marketing surveillance. Low active ingredient content was caused by a faulty weight adjuster in the tableting machine. Risks include treatment failure.
